children: On September 15, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company that it determined to delist NEXTNRG's common stock from the Nasdaq Capital Market after it failed to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement by the September 14 deadline and was ineligible for an additional compliance period. The company intends to request a hearing by September 22, 2026, which will stay any suspension or delisting pending the panel's decision. NEXTNRG effected a 1-for-10 reverse split on September 14, 2026, and shares have traded above $1.00 since, but there is no assurance this will continue.

title: NEXTNRG Received Notice of Delisting
